entry.title: Entry #34 in Public Citizen, Inc. v. Vantage Data Centers Management Company, LLC, 5:26-cv-06032
entry.summary: ORDER GRANTING 32 Motion to Amend/Correct. (a) Plaintiffs are granted leave to file an amended motion for preliminary injunction on or before Monday, November 2, 2026. Defendants responses to the amended motion shall be due on Monday, November 16, 2026, and Plaintiffs reply shall be due on Monday, November 23, 2026. (b) Plaintiffs amended motion for preliminary injunction may not exceed 22 pages. Defendants reserve the right to seek leave to exceed the page limit for their responses after reviewing the amended motion. (c) Defendants deadline to answer or otherwise respond to Plaintiffs Complaint (ECF No. 1), including by any motion under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12, is extended to Monday, November 16, 2026. Plaintiffs response to any such motion shall be due on Monday, December 7, 2026, and Defendants reply shall be due on Monday, December 14, 2026. (d) Defendants have no obligation to respond to Plaintiffs Opposed Motion for Preliminary Injunction filed on September 21, 2026 (ECF No. 6), and the October 29, 2026 deadline for Defendants responses to that motion (ECF No. 27 at 3) is vacated. (e) Nothing in this Order precludes the parties from seeking further extensions of the deadlines set forth in this Order. Signed by Judge Elizabeth S. Chestney. (mgr) (Entered: 10/30/2026)
